svg.text: The talk funnels from a broad survey of failed pseudosciences down into one named diagnosis (Cargo Cult Science)
and its missing ingredient (scientific integrity), then fans that single principle out across a convergent set of
case studies that all illustrate it, ending in a closing wish.

g.text: From pseudoscience to a principle, tested against cases
A funnel: scattered observations of belief-without-results narrow to one diagnosis and one principle, which then is
shown holding across several independent fields.

g.text: What Cargo Cult Science is missing
A chain: the cult story defines the failure, then integrity is spelled out as its cure, contrasted against advertising
and backed by the long run of truth.
